import threading
import time
import service_runtime as runtime

_worker=None
_guard=threading.Lock()
_retry_after={}
_bootstrapped=set()
_local_once48=set()
_stop=threading.Event()


def refresh_local(cancel=lambda:False):
    from startup48 import suspended
    if suspended():return
    from widget_hooks45 import prepare as prepare_widget_bindings
    prepare_widget_bindings()
    if cancel():return
    from portals import get_active
    from xtream import XtreamClient
    from library_index import refresh
    for portal in get_active():
        if cancel():return
        if portal.get('type') not in ('xtream','m3u','stb'): continue
        if time.monotonic()<_retry_after.get(portal['id'],0): continue
        try:
            if portal['type']=='xtream': client=XtreamClient(portal['xc_host'],portal['xc_user'],portal['xc_pass'])
            else:
                from source_adapters import for_portal
                client=for_portal(portal)
            from catalog_delta52 import reconcile_series
            reconcile_series(portal)
            if portal['type']=='xtream' and not hasattr(client,'iter_catalog'):
                refresh(portal,client)
            elif portal['id'] not in _bootstrapped:
                from catalog_sync import request
                from library_index import Reader
                existing=Reader(portal['id'])
                for kind in ('live','vod','series'):
                    if cancel():return
                    if portal.get('include_'+kind,True) and not existing.state(kind):
                        request(portal,kind,portal.get('start_group_id','') if kind=='live' else '',priority=20)
                _bootstrapped.add(portal['id'])
            from guide_store import refresh as refresh_guide
            if cancel():return
            from programme_index46 import prepare_local as prepare_programmes46
            prepare_programmes46(portal,cancel)
            try:
                if portal['id'] not in _local_once48:
                    refresh_guide(portal);_local_once48.add(portal['id'])
            except Exception:
                from utils import warn
                warn('GUIDE_PREWARM_UNAVAILABLE')
            if cancel():return
            # Bounded indexed widget pages replace full-catalogue rail COUNTs.
            # Prepare references in this long-lived data worker, not IR/render.
            from widget_home_probe59 import prepare as prepare_home59
            prepare_home59(portal['id'])
            from widget_data41 import snapshot
            from widget_art44 import prepare
            for kind in ('live','vod','series'):
                if cancel():return
                try:
                    rows,code=snapshot(portal,kind,background=True)
                    if kind=='live':
                        from widget_home50 import rows as start_group_rows56
                        previous_code56=code;rows,code=start_group_rows56(portal)
                        if previous_code56=='READ_ONLY' and code=='READY':code='READ_ONLY'
                    from widget_diagnostics47 import inspect_index
                    inspect_index(portal,kind,rows,code)
                    if kind=='live':
                        from programme_prefetch48 import prepare as prefetch_events48
                        prefetch_events48(portal,rows,cancel)
                    try:
                        prepare(portal['id'],rows)
                        from programme_assets47 import prepare as prepare_assets47
                        prepare_assets47(portal,kind,rows,cancel,provider_only=kind in ('vod','series'))
                    except Exception:
                        from widget_diagnostics47 import note
                        note(portal['id'],kind,'ASSETS','PREPARE_UNAVAILABLE')
                    if cancel():return
                    from widget_live47 import publish
                    publish(portal,kind,rows,code)
                except Exception:
                    # A failed Live/film preparation must not starve the
                    # successful series row or another independent widget.
                    from widget_diagnostics47 import note
                    note(portal['id'],kind,'SELECT','WORKER_UNAVAILABLE')
            _retry_after.pop(portal['id'],None)
        except Exception as exc:
            # A disk-full/over-budget/corrupt import must not reparse the same
            # large local snapshot every 15 seconds. Explicit UI requests are
            # independent; automatic retries wait five minutes.
            _retry_after[portal['id']]=time.monotonic()+300
            from utils import warn
            warn('Local library index: '+type(exc).__name__)


@runtime.background
def _run():
    import xbmc
    monitor=xbmc.Monitor()
    cancelled=lambda:_stop.is_set() or monitor.abortRequested()
    from startup48 import Phases,suspended,mark
    phases48=Phases()
    next_prepare=0
    while not cancelled():
        runtime.emit()
        if suspended():
            if runtime.wait_abort(monitor,.1,_stop):break
            continue
        if runtime.pressure():
            from art_diagnostics import publish
            publish('service','MEMORY_PRESSURE')
            if runtime.wait_abort(monitor,.5,_stop):break
            continue
        worked=False
        try:
            from widget_notice46 import focused
            focused()
        except Exception:pass
        prepare_now=time.monotonic()>=next_prepare
        if phases48.network() and phases48.due('maintenance',300):
            next_prepare=time.monotonic()+5
            try:
                from artwork_db import maintain
                maintain(cancel=cancelled)
            except MemoryError:runtime.note_pressure()
            except Exception:pass
        if cancelled():break
        # Persisted image jobs resume even when catalogue warming is disabled
        # or no fresh media window requests an enrolment. Data worker only.
        try:
            from media_art import ensure_worker
            if phases48.network():ensure_worker()
        except MemoryError:runtime.note_pressure()
        except Exception:pass
        if cancelled():break
        if prepare_now and phases48.network():
            next_prepare=time.monotonic()+5
            # Optional guide/art preparation may fail independently. It must not
            # starve an otherwise valid movie/series sync request.
            started48=time.monotonic()
            try:
                refresh_local(cancelled)
                mark('LOCAL',duration_ms=(time.monotonic()-started48)*1000)
            except MemoryError:runtime.note_pressure()
            except Exception: pass
            if cancelled():break
            try:
                from art_store import prefetch_selected
                if phases48.network() and phases48.due('prefetch',300):prefetch_selected()
            except MemoryError:runtime.note_pressure()
            except Exception: pass
            if cancelled():break
            try:
                from startup_preload import prepare
                if phases48.network():prepare(cancel=cancelled)
            except MemoryError:runtime.note_pressure()
            except Exception: pass
            if cancelled():break
        try:
            from catalog_delta import run_next as run_delta
            worked=run_delta(cancelled) or worked
        except MemoryError:runtime.note_pressure()
        except Exception:pass
        try:
            from catalog_sync import run_next
            worked=run_next(cancelled) or worked
        except MemoryError:runtime.note_pressure()
        except Exception: pass
        if cancelled():break
        try:
            from genre_search import run_next as index_genres
            worked=index_genres(cancelled) or worked
        except MemoryError:runtime.note_pressure()
        except Exception:pass
        if cancelled():break
        try:
            from guide_timers import poll as poll_timers
            poll_timers()
        except MemoryError:runtime.note_pressure()
        except Exception: pass
        if runtime.wait_abort(monitor,0.1 if worked else .5,_stop):break


def poll():
    if _stop.is_set():return
    from app_imports46 import ensure as imports_ready46
    if not imports_ready46():return
    from widget_notice46 import poll as poll_widget_lists
    poll_widget_lists()
    from guide_backup44 import poll as poll_guide_backup
    poll_guide_backup()
    from app_entry import observe
    observe()
    global _worker
    if _stop.is_set():return
    runtime.install()
    from stability_monitor import ensure
    ensure()
    from capture_service import poll as poll_captures
    poll_captures()
    from downloads import poll as poll_downloads
    poll_downloads()
    with _guard:
        if _stop.is_set():return
        if _worker is None or not _worker.is_alive():
            _worker=threading.Thread(target=_run,name='XCMate-library',daemon=True)
            _worker.start()
    from media_autoplay import poll as poll_autoplay
    poll_autoplay()
    from media_progress import poll as poll_media
    poll_media()

    from media_osd import poll as poll_osd
    poll_osd()


def shutdown():
    """Prevent new optional work; never block Kodi waiting on provider IO.

    Already running non-cancellable HTTP may outlive this bounded join. That
    limitation is reported explicitly, rather than claiming a forced stop.
    """
    _stop.set()
    from programme_art46 import shutdown as shutdown_programme46
    from programme_urls55 import shutdown as shutdown_urls55
    shutdown_urls55()
    shutdown_programme46()
    for name in ('downloads','capture_service','media_art'):
        event=getattr(__import__(name),'_stop',None)
        if event is not None:event.set()
    runtime.stop()
    from media_art import shutdown as shutdown_art
    shutdown_art(timeout=.05)
    from stability_monitor import shutdown as shutdown_monitor
    shutdown_monitor()
    from capture_service import shutdown as shutdown_captures
    shutdown_captures()
    from downloads import shutdown as shutdown_downloads
    shutdown_downloads()
    with _guard:
        _stop.set();worker=_worker
    if worker is not None and worker is not threading.current_thread():worker.join(timeout=.2)
    candidates=[worker]+[t for t in threading.enumerate() if t is not threading.current_thread() and (t.name.startswith('XCMate') or t.name.startswith('epg_warmup_') or t.name.startswith('ThreadPoolExecutor'))]
    stopped=all(t is None or not t.is_alive() for t in candidates)
    from boot_diagnostics import mark
    mark('APP_WORKER_STOPPED' if stopped else 'APP_WORKER_STOP_PENDING')
    return stopped

import time, sys, os, threading, uuid
import xbmc, xbmcaddon, xbmcgui

ADDON    = xbmcaddon.Addon()
LIB_PATH = os.path.join(os.path.dirname(__file__), 'resources', 'lib')
SERVICE_BUILD = 48
if LIB_PATH not in sys.path:
    sys.path.insert(0, LIB_PATH)

from utils import setting_bool, setting_int, info, error


def diagnostic(stage,code,**fields):
    from live_diagnostics import record
    record(stage,code,**fields)


# A direct RunPlugin autoplay announces its session before Player.play() has
# completed. Kodi may need several seconds to open the IPTV stream. An idle
# service must not erase that fresh marker using its pre-existing idle timer.
PENDING_LIVE_START_SECONDS = 60


def pending_live_start(session, last_overlay_nonce, now=None):
    """Protect a newly announced TV session until playback has actually begun.

    Once the matching overlay was activated, a stopped video uses the normal
    short cleanup timeout. Stale or malformed sessions receive no grace.
    """
    if not session or session.get('nonce') == last_overlay_nonce:
        return False
    try:
        age = (time.time() if now is None else now) - float(session['at'])
    except (KeyError, ValueError, TypeError):
        return False
    return 0 <= age < PENDING_LIVE_START_SECONDS


class IPTVMasterService(xbmc.Monitor):

    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        from artwork_config import initialize
        try:initialize()
        except OSError:pass  # Fail closed to internal if profile marker cannot commit.
        self._last_epg = 0
        self._epg_worker = None
        self._stopped_since = None
        info('XCMate service started')
        try:self._live_errors67=__import__('live_feedback67').monitor()
        except (TypeError,AttributeError,RuntimeError):self._live_errors67=None
        self._overlay = None
        self._last_session_nonce = ''
        self._last_command_nonce = ''
        self._catalog_worker = None
        self._next_catalog_scan = 0
        self._next_overlay_check = 0
        self._overlay_failure_reported = False
        self._remote_keymap_checked = False
        self._next_recovery_probe = 0
        self._next_diagnostic = 0
        self._next_candidate_probe = 0
        # Undo persistent global keymaps from older XCMate releases unless
        # the user explicitly chose the fallback for their remote control.
        try:
            from remote_control import release_unrequested_keymap
            if release_unrequested_keymap():
                info('XCMate legacy fullscreen keymap safely retired')
        except Exception as exc:
            error('XCMate keymap safety check failed: ' + type(exc).__name__)
        # Reminders start only after the service singleton is held.

    def _start_reminders(self):
        try:
            from reminders import ReminderMonitor
            self._reminder_monitor = ReminderMonitor()
        except Exception as e:
            error(f'reminder monitor: {e}')

    def _maybe_refresh_epg(self):
        if not setting_bool('epg_auto_refresh', True):return
        if time.time()-self._last_epg<60:return
        if self._epg_worker and self._epg_worker.is_alive():return
        self._last_epg=time.time()
        def refresh():
            try:
                import portals as P
                from epg_schedule53 import plan
                from epg import ensure_epg_loaded_for_portal
                for portal in P.get_active():
                    if self.abortRequested():return
                    selected=plan(portal)
                    if not selected:continue
                    # Force bypasses the short-cache age, not the existing
                    # backup/schema/worker gates. Retry only failed sources.
                    job=dict(portal,_epg_auto53=True,_epg_sources53=selected)
                    ensure_epg_loaded_for_portal(job,force=True)
            except Exception as exc:
                error('Service EPG refresh: '+type(exc).__name__)
        self._epg_worker=threading.Thread(target=refresh,name='XCMateEPG',daemon=True)
        self._epg_worker.start()

    def _maybe_warm_catalogs(self):
        """Never fetch Xtream metadata on the Kodi service/remote-control thread."""
        now = time.monotonic()
        if now < self._next_catalog_scan:
            return
        if self._catalog_worker and self._catalog_worker.is_alive():
            return
        self._next_catalog_scan = now + 1800
        def warm():
            try:
                import portals as portal_store
                from xtream import XtreamClient
                for portal in portal_store.get_active():
                    if self.abortRequested():
                        return
                    if portal.get('type') != 'xtream':
                        continue
                    xc = XtreamClient(portal['xc_host'], portal['xc_user'], portal['xc_pass'])
                    xc.warm_catalogs(
                        include_live=portal.get('include_live', True),
                        include_vod=portal.get('include_vod', True),
                        include_series=portal.get('include_series', True))
            except Exception as exc:
                error('XCMate background catalog: {}'.format(type(exc).__name__))
        self._catalog_worker = threading.Thread(
            target=warm, name='XCMateCatalogCache', daemon=True)
        self._catalog_worker.start()

    def run(self):
        from service_health import (inspect, heartbeat, note, INSTANCE,
                                    PHASE, LAST_ERROR, LAST_LIVE,
                                    LAST_OVERLAY, LAST_INPUT)
        marker = xbmcgui.Window(10000)
        if inspect(marker)['alive'] and not getattr(self,'_singleton48',False):
            info('XCMate service: another worker already reports healthy; skipping duplicate')
            return
        from startup48 import Phases,mark as startup_mark48
        phases48=Phases()
        self._start_reminders()
        startup_mark48('SERVICE')
        instance = uuid.uuid4().hex
        loops = 0
        next_input_flush = 0
        heartbeat(marker, instance, loops, phase='gestartet')
        from update_notice41 import detect as detect_update
        try:detect_update()
        except (OSError,RuntimeError,ValueError):pass
        diagnostic('service','STARTED',running=True,count=loops,build=SERVICE_BUILD)
        note(marker, LAST_ERROR, 'keine gemeldet')
        while not self.abortRequested():
            loops += 1
            heartbeat(marker, instance, loops, phase='läuft')
            if time.monotonic()>=next_input_flush:
                next_input_flush=time.monotonic()+1
                from live_diagnostics import flush_input
                flush_input(background=True)
            if time.monotonic()>=self._next_diagnostic:
                self._next_diagnostic=time.monotonic()+30
                diagnostic('service','RUNNING',running=True,count=loops,build=SERVICE_BUILD)
            from exit_jobs import poll as poll_stop_jobs,blocked as stop_blocked
            poll_stop_jobs()
            __import__('live_feedback67').poll()
            from live_stop58 import observe as observe_stop58
            from exit_jobs import state as stop_state58
            observe_stop58(stop_state58())
            if stop_blocked():
                self.waitForAbort(.2)
                continue  # Native Stop may hold Kodi's player lock; no player queries.

# A direct RunPlugin autoplay announces its session before Player.play() has
# completed. Kodi may need several seconds to open the IPTV stream. An idle
# service must not erase that fresh marker using its pre-existing idle timer.
PENDING_LIVE_START_SECONDS = 60


def pending_live_start(session, last_overlay_nonce, now=None):
    """Protect a newly announced TV session until playback has actually begun.

    Once the matching overlay was activated, a stopped video uses the normal
    short cleanup timeout. Stale or malformed sessions receive no grace.
    """
    if not session or session.get('nonce') == last_overlay_nonce:
        return False
    try:
        age = (time.time() if now is None else now) - float(session['at'])
    except (KeyError, ValueError, TypeError):
        return False
    return 0 <= age < PENDING_LIVE_START_SECONDS

                            self._overlay = None
                    if self._overlay is None:
                        session = session_from_property(xbmcgui.Window(10000).getProperty(SESSION_KEY))
                        fullscreen=xbmc.getCondVisibility('Window.IsActive(fullscreenvideo)')
                        # AV playback can precede Kodi's fullscreen activation.
                        # A dialog shown too early can be covered immediately.
                        if session and not fullscreen:
                            diagnostic('dialog','WAIT_FULLSCREEN',marker=True,fullscreen=False)
                        candidate=None
                        if fullscreen and time.monotonic()>=self._next_candidate_probe:
                            self._next_candidate_probe=time.monotonic()+1
                            if marker.getProperty('XCMate.PrePlay.Ready') or marker.getProperty('XCMate.PrePlay.Request'):
                                from preplay import start_navigator
                                candidate=start_navigator(self._last_session_nonce)
                            else:
                                candidate=start_if_eligible(self._last_session_nonce)
                                if candidate is None:
                                    from source_live import start_if_eligible as source_navigator
                                    candidate=source_navigator(self._last_session_nonce)
                        if candidate is not None:
                            try:
                                if not self._remote_keymap_checked:
                                    from remote_control import ensure_for_live_tv
                                    status = ensure_for_live_tv()
                                    xbmcgui.Window(10000).setProperty(
                                        'XtreamMate.KeymapStatus', status)
                                    self._remote_keymap_checked = True
                                xbmcgui.Window(10000).setProperty(
                                    'XtreamMate.OverlayStatus', 'wird gestartet')
                                marker.setProperty('XtreamMate.AutoPopupStatus',
                                                   'TV-Popup wird angefordert')
                                from live_guide_navigation import restore_info
                                restore_info(candidate,getattr(self,'_live_guide_resume',''))
                                self._live_guide_resume=''
                                self._overlay = candidate
                                self._overlay.show()
                                note(marker, LAST_OVERLAY, 'TV-Dialog gestartet')
                                self._last_session_nonce = session['nonce'] if session else ''
                                self._overlay_failure_reported = False
                            except Exception as exc:
                                candidate.close()
                                self._overlay = None
                                xbmcgui.Window(10000).setProperty(
                                    'XtreamMate.OverlayStatus', 'Fehler: ' + type(exc).__name__)
                                note(marker, LAST_OVERLAY,
                                     'TV-Dialog-Fehler: ' + type(exc).__name__)
                                marker.setProperty('XtreamMate.AutoPopupStatus',
                                                   'Fehler: ' + type(exc).__name__)
                                error('XCMate WindowDialog startup failed: '+type(exc).__name__)
                                if not self._overlay_failure_reported:
                                    xbmcgui.Dialog().notification('XCMate',
                                         'TV-Navigation konnte nicht geöffnet werden')
                                    self._overlay_failure_reported = True
                if self._overlay is not None and getattr(self._overlay,'_connecting',False) and not player.isPlayingVideo():
                    self._overlay.tick()
                if self._overlay is not None and player.isPlayingVideo():
                    self._overlay.expire_intro()
                    if time.monotonic() >= self._next_overlay_check:
                        self._next_overlay_check = time.monotonic() + 1.0
                        self._overlay.refresh_from_cache()
                        self._overlay.observe_focus()
                    cmd = parse_command(xbmcgui.Window(10000).getProperty(COMMAND_KEY))
                    if cmd and cmd['nonce'] != self._last_command_nonce:
                        self._last_command_nonce = cmd['nonce']
                        xbmcgui.Window(10000).clearProperty(COMMAND_KEY)
                        self._overlay.handle_command(cmd['action'])
                        xbmcgui.Window(10000).setProperty('XtreamMate.LastHandledKey', cmd['action'])
                        note(marker, LAST_INPUT, 'Bridge: ' + cmd['action'])
            except Exception as exc:
                diagnostic('service','TV_LOOP_FAILED',running=True)
                note(marker, LAST_ERROR, 'TV-Loop: ' + type(exc).__name__)
                error('XCMate TV navigation unavailable: {}'.format(type(exc).__name__))
            self.waitForAbort(0.2)
        try:
            from app_services import shutdown as shutdown_app_features
            shutdown_app_features()
        except Exception:
            diagnostic('service','APP_STOP_FAILED')
        if self._overlay is not None:
            self._overlay.close()
        try:
            from media_autoplay import shutdown as shutdown_autoplay
            shutdown_autoplay()
            from media_progress import shutdown as shutdown_media_progress
            shutdown_media_progress()
        except Exception:
            pass
        if marker.getProperty(INSTANCE) == instance:
            marker.setProperty(PHASE, 'beendet')
        diagnostic('service','STOPPED',running=False,count=loops,build=SERVICE_BUILD)
        from live_diagnostics import checkpoint
        checkpoint()
        info('XCMate service stopped')


def start():
    from artwork_config import initialize
    try:initialize()
    except OSError:pass
    from startup48 import singleton,mark
    with singleton() as acquired:
        if not acquired:
            mark('DUPLICATE','SKIPPED');return
        service=IPTVMasterService();service._singleton48=True;service.run()


if __name__ == '__main__':
    start()

                    events=deduplicate(raw[:100],channel=resolved)

    position=reader.position('live',start['sid'],category) if start and category else None
    start_in_group=position is not None
    position=position if position is not None else 0
    offset=position//ROWS*ROWS

    value=page(portal,offset,origin,category,client)
    value.update(category=category,row=position-offset)

"""Read a complete enabled Live start group in bounded keyset pages.

No COUNT, OFFSET, catalogue import or HTTP. The published generation is pinned
for one read; legacy groups remain supported. Native Kodi owns horizontal
scrolling/texture demand. Only a page is hydrated by each SQLite operation.
"""
import json
import sqlite3
import time
from urllib.parse import quote
PAGE=64


def pages(portal):
    from widget_movie47 import MovieReader
    from library_index import path,initial_group,IndexReadError
    from widget_query44 import groups,get
    reader=MovieReader(portal['id'],kind='live')
    try:
        start=get(reader,'live',str(portal.get('start_stream_id') or ''))
        cid=initial_group(portal,groups(reader,'live'),start)
    finally:reader.close()
    if not cid:return
    db=sqlite3.connect('file:'+quote(reader.filename or path(),safe='/')+'?mode=ro',uri=True,timeout=.05)
    db.row_factory=sqlite3.Row
    try:
        db.execute('PRAGMA query_only=ON');db.execute('BEGIN')
        head=db.execute('SELECT generation FROM heads WHERE pid=? AND kind=? AND cid=?',(reader.pid,'live',cid)).fetchone()
        table='items_v2' if head else 'titles'
        where='pid=? AND kind=? AND cid=?';args=[reader.pid,'live',cid]
        if head:where+=' AND generation=?';args.append(head[0])
        last=None;first=True;pinned=start if start and str(start.get('category_id',''))==str(cid) else None
        while True:
            deadline=time.monotonic()+.25
            db.set_progress_handler(lambda:int(time.monotonic()>deadline),1000)
            suffix=' AND (ordinal>? OR (ordinal=? AND sid>?))' if last else ''
            params=args+(list(last) if last else [])+[PAGE]
            rows=db.execute('SELECT ordinal,sid,payload FROM '+table+' WHERE '+where+suffix+' ORDER BY ordinal,sid LIMIT ?',params).fetchall()
            if not rows:
                if first and pinned:yield [pinned]
                return
            data=[json.loads(row['payload']) for row in rows if not pinned or row['sid']!=pinned['sid']]
            # Pin once; do not lose the final row of the group when it moves.
            if first and pinned:data.insert(0,pinned)
            first=False;last=(rows[-1]['ordinal'],rows[-1]['ordinal'],rows[-1]['sid'])
            if data:yield data
    except sqlite3.Error as exc:
        error=IndexReadError('BUDGET' if getattr(exc,'sqlite_errorname','')=='SQLITE_INTERRUPT' else 'SQLITE_BUSY')
        error.code=str(error);raise error from None
    finally:db.close()


def snapshot(portal):
    """Compatibility list for existing callers; pages are the render hot path."""
    return [row for page in pages(portal) for row in page]


def infos(portal,rows):
    from programme_read47 import memo
    from epg_status import revision
    from epg_handoff63 import profile_scope
    key=('live-text63',profile_scope(),str(portal['id']),str(revision(portal['id'])),
         tuple((str(r.get('sid','')),str(r.get('epg_channel_id',''))) for r in rows))
    return memo(key,lambda:_infos63(portal,rows))


def _infos63(portal,rows):
    from local_epg import now_next
    from epg_sources import configuration
    mappings=configuration(portal['id'])['mappings'];result={}
    from epg_handoff63 import get,meta_key
    from epg_status import revision
    import xbmcgui
    config_revision65=revision(portal['id']);guide_revision65=xbmcgui.Window(10000).getProperty(meta_key(portal['id']))
    missing=[]
    for row in rows:
        sid=str(row['sid']);value=get(portal['id'],sid,mappings=mappings)
        if value is not None:result[sid]=value
        else:missing.append(row)
    if revision(portal['id'])!=config_revision65 or xbmcgui.Window(10000).getProperty(meta_key(portal['id']))!=guide_revision65:
        result={};missing=list(rows)
    for offset in range(0,len(missing),16):result.update(now_next(portal['id'],missing[offset:offset+16],mappings,display_only65=True))
    return result

First OK: compact programme info. Second OK/Down: player controls.
Left opens indexed channels; Left again opens groups. Back returns one level.
Up/Down zap only in full-screen mode. Stop releases playback and dialog.

Kodi handles native list movement before Python callbacks. Bridge commands move
the list explicitly; native events must not move it a second time. No network
requests are made in input callbacks.

def announce(portal_id, stream_id, channel_name=''):

    from live_exit import new_selection

             'name': str(channel_name)[:160], 'at': time.time(),
             'nonce': uuid.uuid4().hex}

    except (AttributeError,RuntimeError,ValueError):pass

def session_from_property(raw, now=None):
    try:
        obj = json.loads(raw)
        if (not isinstance(obj, dict) or not obj.get('pid') or not obj.get('sid')
                or not obj.get('nonce')):
            if raw: trace('session','MARKER_INVALID',marker=True)
            return None
        at=float(obj.get('at',0))
        if not math.isfinite(at):
            trace('session','MARKER_INVALID',marker=True)
            return None
        if abs((time.time() if now is None else now) - at) > 86400:
            trace('session','MARKER_EXPIRED',marker=True)
            return None
        return obj
    except (TypeError, ValueError, KeyError):
        if raw: trace('session','MARKER_INVALID',marker=True)
        return None


def category_rows(categories, enabled):
    """Normal navigation contains active groups only; management keeps all."""
    selected=None if enabled is None else set(map(str,enabled))
    rows=[(str(c['category_id']),str(c.get('category_name') or c['category_id']),True)
          for c in categories if c.get('category_id') not in (None,'') and (selected is None or str(c['category_id']) in selected)]
    return [('*','Alle aktivierten Gruppen',True)]+rows if rows else [
        ('','Keine aktiven Gruppen – Menü: Gruppen verwalten',False)]


def channels_for_category(channels, category_id, enabled):
    active = None if enabled is None else {str(x) for x in enabled}
    return [ch for ch in channels
            if (active is None or str(ch.extra.get('category_id', '')) in active)
            and (category_id == '*' or str(ch.extra.get('category_id', '')) == category_id)]


def adjacent_channel(channels, category_id, enabled, current_sid, step):
    """Next/previous channel in provider order; wrap at group boundaries.

    Categories are identified by provider IDs, never translated display names.
    Disabled categories are excluded. Unknown station: select first/last.
    """
    choices = channels_for_category(channels, category_id, enabled)
    if not choices:
        return None
    current = str(current_sid)
    idx = next((i for i, channel in enumerate(choices)
                if str(channel.extra.get('stream_id', '')) == current), None)
    if idx is None:
        return choices[0 if step > 0 else -1]
    return choices[(idx + (1 if step > 0 else -1)) % len(choices)]

            session=session_from_property(xbmcgui.Window(10000).getProperty(SESSION_KEY))

        self.osd_bg.setImage(__import__('theme_render').texture(self,os.path.join(self._media,'tv_panel.png'),'panel.player.options' if self.mode=='extras' else 'panel.player.controls'))
        paused=bool(xbmc.getCondVisibility('Player.Paused'))
        self.main_buttons[0].setLabel('Weiter' if paused else 'Pause')
        self._button_icons[0][1].setImage(__import__('player_controls').texture('play' if paused else 'pause'))

    def _local_logo(self, channel):
        from logo_cache import local_logo
        return local_logo(getattr(channel,'logo','')) or __import__('theme_render').texture(self,os.path.join(self._media,'tv.png'),'icon.settings.groups' if self.mode=='groups' else 'icon.epg.clock' if self.mode=='guide' else 'icon.live')

    def _render_info(self):
        channel = self.index.by_sid.get(self.sid)
        self._guide.request([channel] if channel else [])
        before=time.perf_counter()
        info = self._guide.get(self.sid)
        from ui_latency39 import mark
        mark(self,'RAM_SNAPSHOT')
        self._snapshot_ms=getattr(self,'_snapshot_ms',0)+(time.perf_counter()-before)*1000
        self._guide.request_infobar45(self.sid)
        from playback_exit import identity

        details=self._stream_details.read(player,token if token and token[0]=='live' and token[1]['pid']==str(self.portal['id']) and token[1]['sid']==self.sid else None)
